description: Define your own Data API request to retrieve exactly the properties, relations or total count you need from a model.
label: Data API Request

options.name: model
options.label: Model
options.info: The model to start the query from.

options.name: query-type
options.label: Type
options.info: Whether your query starts at one record or at a collection of records.

options.name: filter
options.label: Filter
options.info: Data API filter, for example: id: { eq: {{id}} }. Use {{name}} to insert a value from Variables. For text values add the quotes yourself: name: { eq: "{{name}}" }. Do not add outer curly braces: the step does that.

options.name: filter-variables
options.label: Variables
options.info: The values you can insert in the filter with {{name}}. The Data API cannot handle an empty array in a filter: convert it first, for example with an Expression step.

options.name: skip
options.label: Skip
options.info: How many records to skip before the query starts. Any number from 0.

options.name: take
options.label: Take
options.info: How many records to retrieve at most. Empty or 0 means 200.

options.name: sort-order
options.label: Sort order
options.info: The sort direction. Only used when a sort field is filled in.

options.name: sort-field
options.label: Sort field
options.info: The property to sort by. Leave empty for no sorting.

options.name: query-data
options.label: Query data
options.info: The properties and relations to retrieve, in Data API syntax, for example: id name company { id name }. Use camelCase for names that contain an underscore. Not needed when you only want the total count.

options.name: output-type
options.label: Output type
options.info: For a collection: the records (Results) or how many records match in total (Total count, handy when processing large sets in batches). Ignored for a record.

options.name: schema-model
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: The schema model can be used to type the result when it is an object or an array of objects.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: The retrieved record (Object), the list of records (Array) or the total count (Number).
